text.title: Who had the highest peak depends on how you weigh the surfaces
text.subtitle: Each hexagon is one way to mix hard, clay and grass into an overall rating, coloured by who most likely had the highest peak under it; paler = less certain. Djokovic leads for most mixes, including the tour calendar. Nadal takes over once clay is about half to 60% of the weight, Federer once grass is 60% or more. Calendar = share of tour matches on each surface.
